name: WhatsApp Business
summary: Chat with customers on WhatsApp and send approved template messages.

triggers.name: New WhatsApp message
triggers.description: A customer sent a message (webhook messages).

triggers.name: Message status
triggers.description: A sent message was delivered, read or failed.

triggers.name: Template review result
triggers.description: Meta approved or rejected a template.

actions.name: List message templates
actions.description: Lists the business’s message templates and their approval status.

params.name: after
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Create a message template
actions.description: Submits a new message template to Meta for review.

actions.name: List conversations
actions.description: Lists recent WhatsApp conversations Fless has received, and whether each is inside the 24-hour window.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Read a conversation
actions.description: Reads the messages in one conversation from Fless’s message store.

actions.name: Send a WhatsApp message
actions.description: Sends a text message. Only inside the 24-hour customer-service window that opens when the customer last messaged; outside it, use an approved template.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient phone number in international format, e.g. +2348012345678

actions.name: Send a photo, video or document
actions.description: Sends media with an optional caption. Only inside the 24-hour customer-service window that opens when the customer last messaged; outside it, use an approved template.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient phone number in international format, e.g. +2348012345678

actions.name: Reply to a WhatsApp message
actions.description: Replies to a customer’s message, quoting it. Only inside the 24-hour customer-service window that opens when the customer last messaged; outside it, use an approved template.

actions.name: Send a template message
actions.description: Sends an approved template message. Works outside the 24-hour window; Meta charges per message. Marketing templates go only to contacts who opted in.

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient phone number in international format, e.g. +2348012345678

params.name: parameters
params.description: Values for the template’s placeholders, by component

actions.name: Mark as read
actions.description: Marks a customer’s message as read (shows blue ticks).
